capabilities: Mount a real folder as a virtual subfolder under any other folder
Mount a single note in several places pointing to the same file
Create, rename and delete through the virtual entry's native context menu, acting on the source
Follow renames and moves of the source folder automatically
Configure per-mount display options like badges, ordering and item limits
extras: Warns that it depends on Obsidian's internal file-explorer DOM, so a major Obsidian update may break it; virtual paths do not appear in search, Quick Switcher, Graph or wikilinks; installable via BRAT as a beta plugin.
intentEvidence: it reads real TFolder data and injects equivalent nodes into the native file explorer
problem: Obsidian's file index only knows real paths, so the same folder or note cannot appear in several places in the explorer without duplicating or moving files.
summary: Plugin that shows a real folder or note as a virtual subfolder anywhere in the file explorer, without moving, copying or symlinking files.
